items.title: NVIDIA DCGM Exporter Bug Exposes GPU Servers to Resource Exhaustion Attacks
items.description: NVIDIA patched high-severity flaw CVE-2026-47483 in DCGM Exporter that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to exhaust server resources, crash GPU monitoring, and disrupt AI workloads. DCGM Exporter is a common monitoring tool for GPU servers and Kubernetes clusters. items.title: Admin Password “123456” Led to 8.8 Million Danish CPR Data Breach
items.description: A weak administrator password is linked to a major Danish data breach that exposed information tied to about 8.8 million national identification numbers. At least three accounts at Pays, an IT company on the island of Funen, reportedly used “123456”, including an administrator account.
